summary: The quotation must be submitted by the specified date and time.
The bidder must provide the Earnest Money amount and PO/DD number as required by the form.
The vendor must install, commission, and configure Modbus Repeaters for the specified 13 tanks across three defined loops.
The vendor must evaluate the feasibility of using a single booster for Loops 01 and 02, installing two if not viable, with Loop 03 separate.
The scope includes all work necessary to integrate the tanks and loops with the E&H Centralization System.
The system must ensure continuous data transmission from all tanks without distortion or data swapping.
The vendor must provide one year of free support and issue resolution after installation and commissioning.
